title: Add exponential backoff to the payments client
diff:
--- a/payments/client.py
+++ b/payments/client.py
@@ -18,9 +18,16 @@ class PaymentsClient:
-    def charge(self, order_id, cents):
-        resp = self.session.post(self.url, json={"order": order_id, "cents": cents})
-        resp.raise_for_status()
-        return resp.json()
+    def charge(self, order_id, cents, attempts=4):
+        delay = 0.5
+        for attempt in range(attempts):
+            resp = self.session.post(self.url, json={"order": order_id, "cents": cents})
+            if resp.status_code < 500:
+                resp.raise_for_status()
+                return resp.json()
+            time.sleep(delay)
+            delay *= 2
+        raise PaymentsUnavailable(order_id)

title: Make the session cache TTL configurable
diff:
--- a/auth/cache.py
+++ b/auth/cache.py
@@ -3,10 +3,12 @@
-SESSION_TTL = 3600
+import os
+
+SESSION_TTL = int(os.environ.get("SESSION_TTL_SECONDS", "3600"))
 
 class SessionCache:
     def put(self, token, user):
-        self._store.set(token, user, ex=SESSION_TTL)
+        self._store.set(token, user, ex=SESSION_TTL if SESSION_TTL > 0 else None)
